operations.name: Component mount
operations.brief: Mounting of a UI component or application (e.g. initial render/bootstrap).

operations.name: Component update
operations.brief: Updating of an already-mounted UI component.

operations.name: Component resolve
operations.brief: Looking up which component a name in a template refers to, before that component renders.

operations.name: UI task
operations.brief: A task taken on the main UI thread, such as an Ember runloop queue.

operations.name: Main UI thread blocked
operations.brief: A long task or long animation frame on the main UI thread.

operations.name: UI action
operations.brief: A user interaction that starts a new trace segment and collects the work it triggers.

operations.name: Click action
operations.brief: A click that starts a new idle span, named after the current route.

operations.name: Click interaction
operations.brief: A click interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP) or the Event Timing API.

operations.name: Hover interaction
operations.brief: A hover interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

operations.name: Drag interaction
operations.brief: A drag interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

operations.name: Key press interaction
operations.brief: A key press interaction measured via Interaction to Next Paint (INP).

operations.name: Largest contentful paint
operations.brief: A Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) web vital measurement.

operations.name: Layout shift
operations.brief: A Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) web vital measurement.

operations.name: UI
operations.brief: A generic UI operation. Prefer the more specific ui.mount, ui.render, ui.update, and ui.unmount ops.
